name: flow_results_one_line_each
description: A match the session started ends on the results, an overlay on the finished hollow in place of the console's end plate: the title in the game's words, the match in one line, and one row per player with its numbers from the simulation and one positive line each, no line twice. Here an offline match with a caretaker partner, lost.

steps.msg: a tower of mine by the road
the results stand in for the end plate
the title in the game's words

steps.assert: node('ResultsDetail').text.begins_with('High Water · fell in wave %d of 12 · ' % Game.wave)
lines.size() == 2 and lines[0].begins_with('Sascha Lamplighter ') and lines[1].begins_with('Caretaker 1 Lamplighter ')
node('Seat1') != null and node('Seat2') != null and node('ResultsPlayAgain').visible
steps.msg: a row each, and Play again

steps.assert: (node('Rows').get_child(1).find_child('Face', true, false).texture == Game.icon(Game.BUILDERS['lamplighter']['glyph'])) and (node('Rows').get_child(1).find_child('Face', true, false).modulate == Color(1, 1, 1, 1))
steps.msg: each row shows its Builder's face beside the title, as painted
